name: Donald Winnicott (D.W. Winnicott)
shortBio: English pediatrician and psychoanalyst of the British Independent Group who introduced the transitional object, the holding environment, the good-enough mother, and the true vs. false self.
centralQuestion: How does a facilitating environment enable the infant to transition safely from illusion to reality without splitting into a defensive false self?

keyWorks.title: Playing and Reality
keyWorks.description: Defines transitional objects, transitional phenomena, potential space, and creative play.

keyWorks.title: The Maturational Processes and the Facilitating Environment
keyWorks.description: Explores primary maternal preoccupation, maternal holding, and the etiology of the false self.

keyWorks.title: Through Paediatrics to Psycho-Analysis
keyWorks.description: Collected clinical papers linking infant bodily care to psychic integration and hate in the countertransference.
